evidence_summary: The founder confirms that all previously authorized donor source code may be copied, modified, integrated, and rebranded into Skelet. This record scopes that authorization to source-code paths admitted by the AF-01 import manifests. It does not grant rights to third-party datasets, bundled media, model weights, hosted services, brand marks, or trademarks.

authorized_scope.code_scope: Only source-code paths admitted by imports/craft-suite/manifest.json for each donor. Excluded and quarantined paths remain forbidden unless a later governed rights record explicitly admits them.

conditions: Applicable upstream legal notices (LICENSE-MIT, LICENSE-APACHE, NOTICE, ATTRIBUTION, OFL texts, third-party license files) must be preserved for any copied source.

Code rights are distinct from third-party asset rights: Nintendo game sounds, meme images, skybox textures, MMD motion data, Mixamo renders, provider logos, bundled fonts under OFL, Lucide icons under ISC, SCOWL word lists, Adobe CMaps under BSD-3-Clause, SAM3 model code port notes, and all trademarks remain under their own terms.
artcraft-services upstream LICENSE.md is a restrictive Fair Source/WIP grant; reuse relies solely on this founder authorization for the listed narrow code paths, not on an open-source license.
No mandatory paid AI API, GPU hosting, paid cloud service, or founder-funded customer workload may be introduced by any import under this authorization.
Immutable source identity (full 40-hex commit plus tree SHA) must be verified again immediately before any copy. Historical pins are not sufficient evidence at import time.

Skelet PostgreSQL canonical graph, storage, providers, auth, quota, MCP/REST, and rights remain authoritative. No MySQL/Redis/Elasticsearch stack transplant and no second canonical collections database.
